cityScopes.evaton: 46 valid distinct Chief Surveyor-General Erven references verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged Evaton WUP settlement locator. Complete object-ID manifests, forced three-row geometry pages, all 46 fresh native PRCL_KEY reads, explicit absence, footprint and binding passed in 59 requests through the existing strict Esri JSON reader. Independent EPSG:32735 GEOS found no invalid geometries, exact duplicates or operation errors, and one 0.0130704 m² boundary overlap. A fresh original native EPSG:4148 response reproduces that overlap as a strip under one millimetre wide over about 54 metres; both full polygons retain it without repair or exclusion and are accepted for bounded reference use. The publisher states its web dataset is beta/not current and coordinates are not legal values; currentness, legal title, survey accuracy and wider citywide completeness remain unverified.
